verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an official SDK page offering programmatic access through sync and async clients for application code (cekura-docs-5). A separate Cekura SDK integration provides LiveKit agent tracing (cekura-docs-15, cekura-docs-40), so building against official SDKs is a first-party capability. Missing for 10: the supported languages and package distribution are not stated, there is no depth on SDK reference coverage, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
